accepted.diagnosis: The five cited builds are valid and deterministic but their metadata-heavy structured records provide only full-record passages. Adding an exact field-line range after the existing full record and optional overview preserves all current passages and locators while giving native BM25 a focused authoritative retrieval unit.

The structured exact-range behavior is supported by five distinct task checksums and changes the projection contract. The builder workflow must disclose that selected structured interpretation lines are authoritative character ranges rather than generated summaries.

accepted.old: Paper records containing `## PDF page N` headings become exact page passages. The first passage includes any title preamble before PDF page 1. Other records retain one full-record passage. When such a record is at least 10,000 characters and contains a level-two Markdown heading, it also receives one exact overview passage from the body start to the first heading. Whitespace trimming changes every character bound so `record.body[start:end]` always equals the persisted text exactly.
accepted.content: Paper records containing `## PDF page N` headings become exact page passages. The first passage includes any title preamble before PDF page 1. Other records retain one full-record passage. When such a record is at least 10,000 characters and contains a level-two Markdown heading, it also receives one exact overview passage from the body start to the first heading. Each non-page record additionally receives one exact passage for every nonempty Markdown `- **interpretation**:` field line. No field value is rewritten or inferred.
